purpose: Turn a request into a plan the builder can implement without asking questions.
summary: Plan adds a guarded kill recipe beside procs in the stamped justfile and rewords one cookbook sentence to name it.
commit_message: Add spec for the stamped kill recipe
notes_for_next_agent: Use sqlite3 -separator '|' and read pid/command with IFS='|' read -r. Compare `ps -p $pid -o command=` against the recorded command with a prefix match, not equality, because ps may append arguments. Do not use bash-only syntax; the stamped justfile does not set a shell.
